newsitem.title: USA: Andrew Q4 orders rose 38 percent.
newsitem.headline: Andrew Q4 orders rose 38 percent.

text.p: Andrew Corp said Monday orders for the fourth quarter totaled $232.7 million, up 38 percent from $168.5 million last year.
Total backlog grew 16 percent to $168.1 million in 1996 from $144.8 million in 1995.
Andrew, which supplies communications systems equipment and services, reported earnings for the fourth quarter ended September 30 of $0.51 a share, up from $0.41 a year ago.

"In the United States...accelerating personal communications systems (PCS) construction more than offset slower cellular construction," Floyd English, chairman, said in a statement. "International cellular, common carrier and broadcast markets were consistently strong throughout the year."

The Antenna Company, acquired in March 1996, added to the wireless accessories product offering and showed particular strength in the United States with sales growth over 30 percent, Andrew said. The two Brazilian companies acquired in December 1995 were significant contributors to the company's international progress, it added.
